title: Ruby Rabbit's Jumping Puddle
description: Ruby is afraid of jumping over a big puddle, but encouragement from her friends helps her make the leap.
character_reference: a snowy white rabbit with one floppy ear and bright pink overalls

scenes.narration: Ruby Rabbit hopped down the muddy trail after the morning rain, stopping short at a surprisingly wide puddle.
scenes.visual: white rabbit standing at edge of large glossy puddle reflecting blue sky hesitant posture ground level shot

scenes.narration: It stretched all the way across the path, looking more like a small glittering lake than a puddle.
scenes.visual: wide reflective water puddle covering dirt path green grass borders bright daylight ripples on surface

scenes.narration: She backed up three big hops, her nose twitching nervously as she stared across the watery gap.
scenes.visual: rabbit hopping backward setting up jump nose twitching intensely focused expression low angle perspective

scenes.narration: Her friend Pip the hedgehog waddled up to the opposite side and waved his tiny paws in encouragement.
scenes.visual: small hedgehog standing on far side of puddle waving paws encouragingly across the water smiling face

scenes.narration: Pip called out that she was lighter than a feather and stronger than she knew.
scenes.visual: close up of hedgehog talking with cheerful expression leafy green background soft morning light

scenes.narration: Taking a deep breath, Ruby sprinted forward and launched herself up into the bright spring air.
scenes.visual: rabbit mid air flying across puddle with joyful expression outstretched paws action shot side profile

scenes.narration: With a soft thud, she landed safely on the dry grass on the other side, splashing zero mud.
scenes.visual: rabbit landing gracefully on green grass smiling triumphantly ripples seen behind her in water

scenes.narration: Ruby giggled with joy, realizing that facing your fears is much easier with a cheering friend by your side.
scenes.visual: two happy animal friends walking down trail together arm in arm sunny meadow background warm tones

scenes.narration: Follow along for more gentle stories to help you wind down and smile before bedtime.
scenes.visual: peaceful meadow under twilight sky glowing fireflies resting on soft clover patch bedtime ambiance
